show_gameplay.note: WRESTLE.ASM::start_match's PSTATUS==0 (#0plyr) path now runs from the real attract flow: the RNDRNG0(7)-skip-7 index1 draw, LIFEBAR.ASM::init_life_data (LIFE_MAX=163), and #0plyr's PLYRNUM/PSIDE wrestler-actor creation are translated (wm/match.h), and the SLEEP 3*60 + wait_on_butn 10*TSEC timing is exact. Whichever actor draws WM_ROSTER_BRET runs the real wm_arcade_move_bret control layer every tick with a real visual backend (wm/bret_backend.h) and real movement (wm/movement.h): convert_facing, set_velocities, execute_walk's dispatch, and change_walk_anim's leg-cycle reselection (all 12 hrt_walkM_fF_anim sequences) are all translated, so a Bret actor with real input genuinely walks with the correct animation. Its idle stance and 6 light/power punch/kick animations resolve to real wm_visual_sequence data, and each of those 6 now fires ANIM.ASM's real ATTACK_ON/ATTACK_ON_Z/ATTACK_OFF (wm_arcade_ani_attack_on(_z/_off), real since fix38) at the exact frame index hand-traced from each attack's own HRTSEQ2.ASM source, setting real attack_mode/attack_xoff/.../WM_MODE_CHECKHIT. wm_match_tick now also calls the real, ctest-verified-since-fix38 wm_arcade_check_wrestler_collisions()/wm_arcade_wrestler_hit() (REACT1.ASM) every tick through wm_arcade_wrestler_hit_collision_callback, and wm_bret_backend_tick sets a real per-frame victim hurt_box (wm_arcade_set_hurt_box) via wm_bret_hurt_box_for_frame: the original ANI3 hit-box header (SYS.EQU IANI3X/Y/Z/ID) is confirmed unrecoverable (its bretimg.tbl/bret.seq/imgtbl.glo compile output is absent from the checked-in tree, and the WIMP .IMG directory format doesn't carry it either), so this substitutes each frame's own real WIMP image bounds (width/height/xani/yani, via the new geometry-only src/generated/bret_frame_geometry.c -- deliberately separate from wm_bret_sprite_find's pixel data so hit-box math doesn't depend on which artwork happens to be linked in) as the hurt box. A wired attack whose real attack box overlaps that derived hurt box now actually registers a hit and calls the real, shared wm_arcade_adjust_health (wm/arcade/wm_arcade_lifebar.h, LIFEBAR.ASM:1547-1670): life clamped to [0,LIFE_MAX], the 20+pt near-death 'fudge', 'attract mode never dies', and -- once life genuinely reaches 0 -- a real WM_PMODE_DEAD transition (SETMODE DEAD + wres_collis_off) or, when the attacker has an active combo, LIFEBAR.ASM's own 1-HP combo-revival deferral (I_WILL_DIE, currently unreachable since nothing sets combo_count yet). The same function backs BRET.ASM mode_normal's own I_WILL_DIE self-death resolution (wm_bret_backend_callbacks now wires adjust_health for real instead of leaving it NULL). LIFEBAR.ASM's DAM_MULT/COMBO_COUNT damage multiplier, damage_mod_table/speed_adjustment scaling, the LAST_DAMAGE timestamp update, and everything past SETMODE DEAD (death sound, wrestler-type death-animation dispatch, royal-rumble/8-on-1 bookkeeping) are not translated -- a dead actor's player_mode changes but nothing renders it. wm_match_tick also now steps wm/arcade/wm_arcade_round.h's wm_arcade_round_tick every tick: WRESTLE2.ASM::match_timer's real get_live_bits() check plus its 5-second (WM_ARCADE_PIN_TIMEOUT_TICKS = 5*TSEC) pin-idiot-check countdown -- the actual source trigger for a round ending on a knockout, not just its round clock running out. Once one PLYR_SIDE has no live wrestler, the countdown starts for real; when it elapses, wm_match_state.round_state.decided/decided_winner_side become real (a simultaneous double-KO resolves as a draw, decided_winner_side=-1, rather than guessing at the unported PIN system's real tie-break). Not translated: match_timer's own CREATE PINHIM_ANIM_PID pin-prompt process and the buckoff/reversal window announce_rnd_winner grants afterward, 8-on-1/8-on-2 team bookkeeping and crowd-wake (no team system exists here), match_time's on-screen countdown display and its ADJSPEED-based decrement rate, and everything once a round is actually awarded (set_winner's pin-based winner selection, DO_ROUNDS/p1rounds/p2rounds best-of-3 tracking, match_over, postgame_audits, and the announcer itself) -- wm_match_tick keeps ticking after round_state.decided becomes true; nothing yet acts on it. This connects for real once an attacker plays a wired attack animation. wm/arcade/wm_arcade_closest.h now translates WRESTLE.ASM's calc_closest delta/distance computation (closest_xdist/closest_ydist/closest_zdist/closest_dist against actor->smart_target) and wm_match_tick calls it every tick before wm_arcade_move_bret, so BRET.ASM's do_punch (near(a,50,45)) sees real distances instead of the permanent 0/0 that used to make every punch resolve to the unwired WM_BRET_ANIM_BUTT2/4 headbutt: a human punching from realistic (non-point-blank) range now gets a real, wired punch animation through ordinary play. calc_closest's own multi-candidate ranking loop (biased_range, ONGROUND/WHOIHIT/INRING/previous-closest/combo/Z-distance biasing, the running-behind-us skip rule, CLOSEST_NUM selection itself) is not translated, since it only matters when choosing among more than one live opponent and this port's smart_target is already fixed to a single opponent at match creation; nor is calc_closest2's every-4th-tick recompute throttle, a pure CPU-cost optimization irrelevant to a fixed pair. closest_dist itself uses a standard integer square root rather than SQUARE.ASM's fast quantized table-lookup approximation, since near()/mode_block (the only real consumers) read only closest_xdist/closest_zdist, which are exact either way. Also not translated: change_walk_anim's TORSO half and set_rotate_anim/change_anim1 (idle-turn animation; real FACING_DIR tracking needs an as-yet-unlocated shared 'compute NEW_FACING_DIR' routine, substituted with MOVE_DIR while moving), INIT_LADDER_TABLE/CURRENT_LADDER/NUM_OPPS multi-drone team selection (one placeholder opponent only), and DRONE.ASM's wnshort_t/wnmed_t/wnlong_t script data and blkbase_t/blkatk_t/sklhhdly_t/sklhrdly_t skill tables (SKLM macro expansion not in the checked-in source tree, so not guessed) -- meaning a CPU-controlled wrestler never actually throws a button/stick input.

start_match.note: Two of start_match's three creation paths are translated in wm/match.h: PSTATUS==0 (#0plyr, attract-mode, driven from WM_ATTRACT_SHOW_GAMEPLAY) via wm_match_start_attract, and PSTATUS!=0 single-human (#1plyr) via wm_match_start_selected, now reachable for real from WM_APP_MODE_MATCH_INIT after select/pregame (app.c's previous dead-end stub). The #1plyr path uses whatever the select screen actually chose (wm_pregame_state::player_source_wrestler, i.e. SELECT.ASM's real scramble_table mapping, not a random draw) and a real human control layer: wm/human_input.h maps the platform's wm_input_state onto the same but_val_cur/stick_val_cur fields DRONE.ASM's commit path writes, so a human playing Bret gets real wm_arcade_move_bret dispatch, real execute_walk movement (wm/movement.h), and the visual backend (wm/bret_backend.h) driven by genuine button/stick input rather than an always-idle drone. #2plyr (two humans) is not translated. Neither path creates a real opponent team: CURRENT_LADDER/NUM_OPPS is unported, so both fall back to one placeholder-drawn opponent. CLOSE_PROGRESS_SCREEN, ring/rope/crowd/timer process creation, and collision/pin/finisher lifecycle are all still unported for both paths -- see the show_gameplay note above for exactly what wrestler control/animation coverage exists today (Bret only).

Credit/buy-in process wiring, original objects/text/mug art and full select process orchestration remain.

audio.note: Original game-side DCS command semantics/backend not translated.

background_blimp_bdd.note: Paired BDB/BDD BLIMP data is decoded as raw source blocks plus palettes and cross-validated against compiled BMOD records; NTITLESC is wired block-for-block with no WIMP crop or flattened recreation.

source_clock.note: DISPLAY.EQU TSEC=53 is executed independently of 60 Hz N64 presentation using an accumulator; literal 60-tick source sleeps remain literal.

source_process_scheduler.note: Cooperative CREATE/sleep/kill-by-PID execution is shared by translated attract processes; full MPROC semantics and process pdata remain to port.

bmod_packed_records.note: BAKGND.ASM 64-bit block records decode exactly and CI extracts NTITLESCBMOD/SPORTBKBMOD verbatim from BGNDTBL.ASM. NTITLESC now consumes header index, palette, Z and MAP_FLAGS transparency at render time; the reusable renderer still needs extending to remaining backgrounds.

typed_animation_stream.note: Mixed WORD/LONG source stream supports frame refs, REPEAT, SETMODE, velocity LONG operands/modes, PAUSE, SETSPEED, zero velocities, facing/xflip and END. Unknown commands stop explicitly.

source_dependency_ir.note: CI scans every SUBR/SUBRP and static CALL/JSRP/CREATE edge and emits dependency frontiers for attract_mode and start_match without inventing unresolved dynamic semantics.

animation_source_ir.note: CI scans typed WORD/LONG animation data and W/L packing macros across the original ASM tree, preserving source expressions and unresolved forms without inventing pointer or command semantics.
